events.title: The Port Royal Earthquake of 1692
events.summary: On 7 June 1692 (Julian / Old Style), an earthquake struck Port Royal, Jamaica, as recorded in eyewitness accounts transmitted to the Royal Society (Archives EL/L5/117; Phil. Trans. Vol. 18, No. 209, 1694).

events.title: Capture of the Richard & Sarah
events.summary: The English-built vessel Richard & Sarah of London, on a recorded voyage from Jamaica to London, was taken at Dartmouth, Devon in May 1705 and recorded in High Court of Admiralty Prize Papers.

events.title: Capture of the William
events.summary: The 60-ton English-built vessel William, on a recorded voyage from Jamaica to London with muster at Jamaica, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in September 1702 and recorded in High Court of Admiralty Prize Papers.
